name: Orca MSI Editor
description: MSI database table editor used for installer inspection and packaging.

postInstall: $orcaMsi = Get-ChildItem -Path 'C:\SandboxToolbox\Tools\OrcaInstaller' -Filter '*.msi' -Recurse -File | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $orcaMsi) { throw 'No Orca MSI was found after extraction.' }; $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'msiexec.exe' -ArgumentList @('/i', $orcaMsi.FullName, '/qn', '/norestart') -Wait -PassThru; if ($p.ExitCode -notin @(0,3010)) { throw "Orca MSI installer failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)." }
